tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lam rim dang mthun pa'i smon lam bzhugs so// ༈ /de ltar bdag gis byang chub bar gyi skyabs// bla ma mkha' spyod dbang mo'i dkyil 'khor la// mchod cing bstod pas rab tu dges mdzad nas// bsam don 'di rnams yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// dal 'byor gru chen mi rtag dran pa yi// ba dan dkar po bskyod pa'i las 'bras kyi// blang dor mthun pa'i rlung gis rab bskul nas// 'jigs rung 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /skyabs gsum gser gyi cod pan spyi bor bcings// byang chub sems gnyis nor bu'i do shal mdzes// rdor sems bdud rtsis nyes ltung dri ma bkrus// bslu med bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par mdzod// yid 'ong rgyal yum phyi yi rnal 'byor ma// bam̐ yig nang gi rdo rje btsun mo'i mchog /sems nyid stong gsal gsang ba'i mkha' spyod yum// rang zhal mthong ba'i brtse dgas rol par mdzod// snod kyi 'jig rten e yig gzhal med khang*// bcud kyi sems can bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyis// cir snang dag pa'i snang ba 'char bar mdzod// de ltar bskyed rim gsal ba'i pho nya mchog /rigs ldan mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab dus// dbu mar rlung zhugs gnyis med ye shes 'bar// ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs chen 'byed par shog /sgyu ma mkhan po 'khrul 'khor gnad la mkhas// gdol pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa dang*// shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa ltar// kun kyang lus kyi gnad la mkhas par mdzod// rtog bcas sems dang zag bcas lus bskyed pa// rtsa gnas so sor zhugs pa'i rlung sems rnams// dbu mar thim pas mi rtog chos sku dang*// zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob mdzod// thun chen drug la thun chung sum cu po// re re re re 'phel ba goms pa'i mthus// rlung sbyor rgyal po dpal ldan kum bha kas// las rlung ma lus dbu mar zhugs par mdzod// lte ba'i pad+mor rlung lda'i ti la kar// rtse gcig bsgoms pa'i kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyis// lus sems rtsa la dri zhon zhugs pa yis// bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshim par mdzod// lus sems rtsa la rlung rnams rim zhugs pa// de tshe tshor bde mi rtog bde ba dang*// mtshon byed dpe yi ye shes legs skyes nas// gsal la rdzogs pa'i rtags bcu 'char bar mdzod// sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i las kyi gtum mo dang*// bde chen 'khor lo'i 'od kyi gtum mo gnyis// chos kyi 'khor lor ro mnyam 'dres pa yis// bde drod ye shes lhag par 'bar bar mdzod// rdo rje btsun mo nyi ma 'bum gyi gzis// 'od gzugs gangs ri'i dbang po zhu ba las// a wa dhu tir 'bar 'dzag rnam rol bas// bde stong mchog gi dpal la rol par mdzod// chos zab rnal 'byor bcu gcig la 'bad pas// nam zhig dus na dga' ma byi ru'i mdog

/li khri'i skra grol dmar ser mig g.yo bas// mngon sum rig 'dzin grong du khrid par mdzod// sin+dhu laṅga li yi sdong bur bcas// ro gdan gnas su bsgrubs shing yul kun tu// nyul bas gang gi mdzod spur 'khyil ris can// 'phos pa'i mdzes mas mkha' la 'khrid par mdzod// nang gi phag mos gzung 'dzin 'khril zhing bcom// mchog gi dhū tīr zhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma// tshangs pa'i sgo nas sprin lam dbyings su 'thon// khrag 'thung dpa' bor 'khyud cing rol bar mdzod// skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis// stong gsal brjod du med pa gnyug ma'i ngang*// zung 'jug blo 'das rang sems rnal 'byor ma// rang ngo shes nas rtag tu skyong bar mdzod// rtsa rlung thig le e waṃ dbyings su thim// sems nyid bde chen chos sku'i dpal thob nas// bgrang yas gzugs sku'i rnam rol dpag med kyis// 'gro kun mkha' spyod gnas su khrid par shog /ces brjod pas gsol ba gdab bo// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bkra shis glo bo pas mdzad pa bzhugs// ༈ /shrī tsakra sam+bha ra/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+mar rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi 'byung gnas nyams dga' bar// sna tshogs chu skyes nyin byed gdan la bde bar bzhugs// rgyal ba ma lus skyed pa'i yum gyur rnal 'byor ma// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig gsang chen zab mo'i don ston pa// mkha' 'gro grangs med gsung gi snying po sum cu gnyis// sa gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer bye ba'i 'phro 'du can// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig 'gyur med lhun gyis grub pa'i dbyings// khams gsum kun la bde ba chen pos khyab pa'i thugs// tshad med yon tan phrin las 'od kyis cher 'bar ba// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog

/bkra shis gang zhig zhing skyong ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyis// bdud dang bgegs 'joms zhi rgyas dbang gi las mdzad cing*// srung ba'i 'khor lo rgya chen rtag tu gnas gyur pa// bkra shis des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis 'di sgrub mchod kyi cha rkyen dge slong pu ṇ+ya pas bris pa lags// ༈ /rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i bstod gsol byin rlabs myur 'jug ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī ye/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum// 'gro la rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo// dpal ldan mkha' spyod dbang mor bdag phyag 'tshal// longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde ba che// rang bzhin mi dmigs snying rjes yongs su gang*// phrin las rgyun mi chad cing 'gogs pa med// sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan dbang mor bstod// gar dgu'i nyams ldan phrin las sna tshogs gar// gar gyis 'gro kun don gnyis ldan par bsgyur// bsgyur mdzad grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mchog /mchog khyod bcos zol min par snying nas bstod// drug cu rtsa gnyis 'khor lo smin byas nas// lhan skyes ngo sprod byin rlabs sgo phye ste// mkha' spyod bskyed rdzogs lam la rtag bsgrubs pas// mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang thob par mdzod// he ru ka dpal gsung gi bden pa dang*// nyid kyis mkhas grub grangs yas rjes bzung tshul// bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i bden pa yis// myur du 'dzum zhal dga' mas rjes 'dzin shog /de ltar tshe 'di mkha' spyod dbang mo'i zhal// mngon sum mjal ba'i skal ba med na yang*// 'chi ba'i rnam rtog 'pho bas mtshams sbyar nas// bar do med pa mkha' spyod 'grub par shog /gal te rnam shes bar dor 'khyams srid na// 'jigs pa'i dgra bzhi nyam nga g.yang sa gsum// ma nges rtags drug la sogs shar ba'i tshe// de yi rkyen gyis drin chen bla ma dang*// dga' ba gsum gyi rnal 'byor dran pa'i mthus// de ma thag tu mkha' spyod dbang mo dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis mdun bsus te// phyin chad las nyon skye sgo chod par shog

/bla ma yi dam mchog gsum thugs rje dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i mthu stobs dang*// chos nyid 'gyur med rten 'brel bslu med mthus// smon pa'i gnas 'di 'gegs med 'grub gyur cig /ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bstod pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni/ dge slong chos dkar gyis yi ge'i lam nas yang yang bskul ba'i gsung ngor/ bya bral ba sangs rgyas ming can gyis e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsol 'debs thugs rje myur bskul zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ ma lus rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum mchog ma// mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od zer stong 'phro ba// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo rje btsun ma// mi phyed dang ba'i yid kyis bstod pa bgyi// khyed thugs gdod nas zhi ba'i sku brnyes kyang*// mkha' ltar rnam dag brtan g.yo kun gyi dngos// ma lus 'gro la brtse ba'i dpal mnga' ba// mkha' spyod chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs// zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i rnam rol gyis// srid gsum ma lus bde bas tshim mdzad cing*// zag pa med pa'i bde la rtag rol ba// bde chen longs spyod rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs// mtha' yas gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa bzhin// gang la gang 'dul de de'i skur ston pa'i// gdul bya thar lam mchog la 'god mdzad pa// rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// khyod sku pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la// nyi gzhon bye bas 'khyud 'dra'i 'od zer 'phro// mthong ba'i mod la snying gi gdung ba 'phrogs// mkha' spyod dbang mo'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// bcu phrag gsum dang zung lhag yi ge'i grangs// ngag dang yid kyis rgyun du bzlas pa'i mthus// brjod bral bde chen myur du stsol mdzad ma// mkha' spyod dbang mo'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs// 'khor ba 'ching byed thar lam rnam rtog 'di// dag pa bde ba chen por sgyur byed ma// rdzogs rim mthar thug zung 'jug dbu ma'i lam// myur stsol dbang mo'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs// khyod dang dbyer med bla ma'i bka' drin las// khyod kyis gsang ba'i man ngag legs thob nas// le lo spangs te brtson par rab bsgom nas// tshe 'dir mkha' spyod mngon sum mthong bar shog

/'on kyang bdag blo nyon mongs tshan ches pas// tshe 'dir rjes su 'dzin pa'i skal dben kyang*// 'chi kha'am bar dor khyod kyis rjes bzung nas// mkha' spyod gnas su khrid par mdzad du gsol// ces rje btsun rdo rje btsun mo la gdung shugs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yang*/ dad ldan gyi slob bu glo mkhan gyi bzhed pa skong phyir mkhyen rab bla ma'i bran gyur bya bral bas dben nas rmor dgon par bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i zhing gi bkod pa dang mthun par bstod pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyis rab bsngags pa'i// grangs med ma dang mkha' 'gros bsten pa'i gnas// rdo rje btsun mo mchog gi pho brang che// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas der gus pas 'dud// 'di nas steng gi phyogs su rab bgrod par// pad+ma rā ga'i sa gzhi brdal ba'i dbus// phyogs mtshams thams cad rin po che las grub// sa gzhi khyad par 'phags der gsol ba 'debs// de dbus rin chen lnga las legs grub pa'i// mkha' spyod dbang mo'i ye shes khang chen po// gru bzhi sgo bzhi thog phub rim gsum rtser// rdo rje'i tog gis mdzes der gsol ba 'debs// gzhal med khang dbus chos 'byung nyis brtsegs dang*// pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan steng*// bdag gi yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// mtshan dang dpe byed 'bar der gsol ba 'debs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum gyen du gzigs// g.yas pas gri gug g.yon pas thod pa dang*// g.yon gyi gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yis mdzes// phyag rgya lnga yis spras der gsol ba 'debs// gzhal med khang gi steng gi ba gam nang*// nā ro ta pa bla chen brtse ba che// tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa// brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis mdzes der gsol ba 'debs// pho brang steng mar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// dbyer med rigs bdag sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// sku mdog dmar po rdor dril thugs kar bsnol// skyabs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs// gzhal med khang gi 'khyams sogs phyogs kun tu// mkha' la spyod pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// sprin gyi phung po gtibs ltar bzhugs pa kun// bdag la brtse bas dgongs der gsol ba 'debs// de ltar bdag gis tshe rabs thams cad du// nye bar bstan pa'i rje btsun rnal 'byor ma// rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad la// byang chub bar du gus pas skyabs su mchi// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// lus ngag yid kyi sdig ltung so sor bshags// skye 'phags dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs su gsol// dge tshogs bla med byang chub chen por bsngo// deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// rdo rje btsun mos nye bar bskyang du gsol// mkha' spyod zhing gtso phyi yi rnal 'byor ma// snying kha'i bam̐ yig nang gi btsun mo che// gsal stong zung 'jug don gyi rnal 'byor ma// rang ngo shes nas mkha' spyod bgrod par shog

/nam zhig sgyu ma'i skyes chen 'degs pa'i tshe// gtan gyi skyabs gcig mkha' spyod dbang mo des// 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang glu dbyangs rol mo'i sgras// dag pa'i zhing der 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i zhing gi bkod pa dang mthun par bstod pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di yang rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa mkhyen blo brtan don rnams kyis nan gyis bskul ma gnang ba'i ngor bya bral lhun grub kyis lha ldan gan+dho la'i dbang phyogs su bris pa 'dis kyang sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byed par gyur cig/ ༈ /

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i tshogs mchod bya tshul nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ bla ma mchog dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma// rtse gcig dang ba'i yid kyis gus btud nas// dngos grub 'gugs dang dam tshig gso ba'i phyir// tshogs kyi mchod pa mdor bsdus bshad par bya// 'dir rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i tshes bcu dang sbyin sreg la sogs pa'i dus su med du mi rung ba'i tshogs mchod mdor bsdus bya ba'i tshul la/ sbyor ba ni sgrub mchod yin na sin dkyil gyi mdun du/ sbyin sreg gi tshe mchod pa'i mdun du tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor ba khyad par thod pa'i snod du/ ma dā na dang*/ ba la la sogs pa bkod pa mdzes par bsham/ dngos gzhi sgrub mchod yin na gtor bsngo'i mjug tu/ sbyin sreg gi tshe 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i rjes su tshogs rdzas rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ tshogs pa mang po yod na las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal nas/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams la byin rlabs gnang ba zhu/ zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan mang brjod pas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes par gyur par bsam pa ni shin tu gal che bas dmigs pa ma yengs par bya/ de nas tshogs kyi phud nas snod gcig tu blugs pa dang*/ ma dā na snod gcig tu blugs pa dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du phul/

gtor ma rnams la yang phud thams cad nas ma lus par phul/ slar yang thams cad la nang mchod chu chang gis bran las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi drung du sman phud phul bar zhu/ zhes brjod/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /ces brjod/ yang phyag gsum btsal la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gi drung du tshogs phud phul bar zhu/ zhes brjod/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /ces brjod/ yang phyag gsum btsal la/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi drung du tshogs phud phul bar zhu/ zhes brjod/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tse nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na two ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes rje btsun ma la phul/ de nas gur mgon lcam dral sogs kyi gtor ma yod na yang so so'i gtor sngags kyis 'bul/ mthar oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags dang*/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i chos bsgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/

ces phud kyis dkon mchog mchod/ de nas dam tshig spel ba'i phyir rdo rje slob dpon gyi drung du ma dā na'i pad+ma bhan+dha dpral ba rang la bstan pa bzhag de'i steng du ba la cung zhig bzhag pa las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal/ pad kor byas la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol// bdag gi tshogs kyi khyad par 'di// dang ba'i sems kyis 'bul lags kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// dpon slob rnams kyis/ e ma zhi ba chen po kye// tshogs chen 'bar bas nyon mongs bsreg /de 'dra'i bde ba chen po ste// kun kyang a ho su kha che// a ho mahā su kha ho// zhes brjod/ yang phyag gsum dang*/ pad kor byas la/ 'di ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa la ni the tshom de// bram ze gdol pa khyi dang phag /rang bzhin gcig tu rol tu gsol// ces pa'i lan du/ bder gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ /zhes brjod/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes lag pa gnyis pad+ma'i phyag rgya las srin lag g.yas kyis steng gi ba la 'dzin pas rdo rje slob dpon nas rim bzhin ma dā na 'grim tshar ba dang*/ tshogs kyi rdzas rnams ma tshang ba med pa slob dpon la nyis gyur sogs dpon slob thams cad la lag pa gnyis kas dbul zhing*/ len pa pos kyang lag pa gnyis kas pad kor gyis blang bar bya zhing*/ a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod cing blang dgos te/ he badz+ra las/ pad+ma'i lag pas blang ba dang*// de nyid kyi ni lag pas dbul// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de nas thams cad la phul zin pa dang sa rjen la mi 'jog cing*/ slob dpon gyis/ thams cad tshogs la rol bar zhu zhes brjod/ 'di dag gi skabs su snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben par byas la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis gtsang sme'i rnam rtog mi bya bar snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mchod pa'i bsam pas rdzas thams cad tshim par longs spyod/

khyad par dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bus sdom la 'og ma'i bcas pa bsrung ba'i bsam pas ma dā na dang*/ phyi dro'i kha zas spang sems kyis tshogs khyad du bsad na rtsa ltung du 'gyur te/ dam tshig rdzas ni ji bzhin rnyed// mi bsten pa de bcu gsum pa// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// tshogs kyi dus thams cad du rtsod pa dang kha shags 'gyed pa sogs mi bya bar chos kyi gleng dang*/ rdo rje'i glu gar la sogs pas dus 'da' bar bya'o// de yang tshogs kyi skabs su sha la ba la dang*/ chang la ma dā na la sogs pa'i brda skad bya dgos te/ he badz+ra'i rgyud las/ gal te sangs rgyas gsang ba'i skad// mi gsung na ni 'grongs par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gsang ba'i skad kyis mi smra bar// de yi dam tshig nyams par ni// 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de nas thams cad kyis tshim par longs spyod pa'i rjes su/ las kyi rdo rjes snod gcig tu mas rim gyis tshogs lhag bsdus pa mtshan mo yin na grib gnon gyi gdon bsrung ba'i phyir dpal 'bar dang bcas rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du stegs kyi steng du bzhag chu gtsang dang slob dpon gyis chang gi kha phru 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i bar nas gtor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ u tsi ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ 'byung po lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin no// ngoms shing tshim pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig ces phyi rol du dor/ ḍā dril dang rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya zhing*/ kol+la i ri t+ṭhe la sogs pa rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis smon lam dgyes rdor bzhin bya/ cho ga'i mjug dkyus bzhin bya'o// yang tshogs pa mang po med cing las slob kyi 'os su gyur pa med na las slob kyi ngag 'don rnams dor la gzhan tshig bcad lhug thams cad rang gis brjod la dmigs pa dang ma bral bar bya ba nyid do// de yang rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi tshogs mchod mdzad pa 'ga' zhig gis ni yod pa'i sgo bor nas med pa'i srang 'chag pa ltar rang gi yi ge bzhag nas rnying ma'i yi ge la dpe blangs nas mdzad pa yang phan tshun 'dres pa'i phyag len ma legs par mthong zhing*/

'dir ni bla ma rje btsun chen po dang*/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta khu dbon dang*/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don ngor chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsung rab gsang ba kun rgyan dang*/ kun bzang rnam rol gyi dgongs don 'khrul pa med pa'o// de ltar mkha' spyod ma dpal la// tshogs kyi mchod pa bya ba'i tshul// nyung ngu rnam gsal bkod 'di yang*// gzhan la phan pa'i blo yis so// zhes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshes bcu dang sbyin sreg sogs la nye bar mkho ba'i tshogs mchod bya tshul nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ 'ga' zhig gis ni sna tshogs bsres/ 'ga' zhig gis ni bya 'dod kyang lag len gyi 'brang la rdugs par mthong nas gong smos kyi bstan bcos de rnams kyi dgongs don dang*/ rje bla ma brgyud par bcas pa'i phyag len 'khrul med rang bzo'i dri mas ma gos par drin chen rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor yun ring du bstan pa'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal lhun grub kyis rang dang skal ba mnyam pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas tha skar zla ba'i dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus kyi tshe dpal ldan rmor gyi rang gi bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba'o// 'di dag gi go rgyu dang mtha' dpyod dang lag len rgyas par gong ma'i yi ge de rnams las rtogs par bya'o// dge'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs mchod zab don nying khu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra wā ra hī/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus mkha' spyod dbang mo dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// phyi nang mkha' 'gro mchod pas mnyes phyir du// zab don nying khu tshogs mchod cho ga 'bri// 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos mtha' dag gi yang rtse skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag la dus 'dir mchog gi dngos grub 'bad med du stsol ba'i nges tshig rgyud dang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bsngags pa'i don bzhin mi bslu ba'i bdag nyid dpal mo mkha' spyod dga' ma'i tshogs mchod dam pa mang po'i gsung rab las 'byung ba bzhin lhan cig tu rang gzhan 'jug pa bde ba'i phyir bkod pa la/

spyi don dang*/ gzhung don gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rnam par bshad pa bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rnam bzhag cung zad bshad par bya ba la don gnyis te/ rgyun gyi dang*/ khyad par gyis so// dang po la/ bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa'i tshul/ de ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul/ bsten pa las byung ba'i phan yon no// dang po ni/ rgyud las/ na dang ga ha dang po dang*// mtha'i shwa dang dang po'i shwa// kye yi rdo rje'i dngos grub phyir// bdud rtsi lnga dang de bzhin za// zhes sogs dang*/ saṃ ṭi las/ ye shes lcags kyu rab dbye bas// yid kyis thams cad dgug pa 'o// zhes dang*/ phyag thig las/ mi bskyod pa ni dri yi chu// rin chen dbang po'i khrag ces bshad// snang ba mtha' yas khu bar brjod// don yod grub pa sha chen te// rnam par snang mdzad rtug par bshad// 'di rnams bdud rtsi lnga mchog go /zhes sogs kyi rdzas dang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ dang por rnam snang de rjes su// rdo rje ma yi mtha' ru hūm̐// bza' ba dang btung ba byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags so// zhes dang*/ saṃ ṭi las/ ha yis kha dog 'phrog par byed// hoḥs ni dri ni 'jigs par byed// hrīḥs ni brtson 'grus 'jig par byed// rim pa 'di ni brjod par bya// rnam gsum lan gsum brjod pas ni// gsum gyis lha rnams tshim par bya// zhes sogs kyis gtor ma thun mong du byin rlabs bstan la/ de yi dbus nas blangs nas ni// de na bdud rtsi myong bar bya// zhes sogs kyis myong ba'i tshul bstan te/ rgyas par phyag thig le'u bcu gnyis par 'byung zhing*/

lag tu blang ba ni man ngag gi skabs su shes par bya'o// gnyis par bsten tshul ni/ thun gyi thog mtha' 'am thun re'am/ zhag re'am zla ba re la re re bsten la/ de ma grub na zla ba drug nas sam/ tha na'ang lo re'i dpyid zla 'bring por tshes gcig gam bco lnga la re re bsten no// de ltar yang dus 'khor 'grel chen las/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i ril bu yungs kar gyi tshad tsam nyi ma so sor dam tshig bstan pa'i don du'o// zhes so// gsum pa phan yon ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ tshe dang lus kyi bcud len du 'gyur ba ste/ rgyud las/ rga shis zil gyis mi gnon zhing*// rtag tu bsrung bar 'gyur ba yin// sogs dang*/ gur las/ mi bskyod bsten pa'i rnal 'byor pas// nad rnams thams cad rnam par spangs// zhes so// mthar thug phan yon ni/ gsang 'dus las/ sha chen dam tshig mchog gis ni// rdo rje gsum mchog 'grub par 'gyur// zhes so// 'di dag kyang de kho na nyid shes pas yin gyi/ gang zag gzhan gyis ni de ltar ma yin te/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ gsang ba 'dus pa mi shes par// sbas pa'i brtul zhugs spyod byed pa// khyi dang phag dang wa rnams ni// spyod pa dag ni ston par byed// ces so// de kho na nyid gang yin zhe na/ sbyang gzhi mtshon byed sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga/ sbyong byed rigs lngas sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras ye shes lnga 'byung bar shes nas nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lngar 'gyur pa'i phyir dag ma dag gi rnam rtog med par bsten pa ste/ gdan bzhi las/ lcags kyu che la bkod pa ni// ye shes lhar ni dgod pa ste// rdo rje lcags kyu mi bskyod pa// gnas kyi lcags kyu rin chen dbang*// rgyal po'i lcags kyu don yon grub// g.yo ba'i lcags kyu 'od dpag med// lcags kyu lnga la sogs pa la// de nyid thams cad sbyar bar bya// zhes so// sha lnga la ci'i phyir lcags kyu zhes bya zhe na/

dpal ldan rtse mo zhabs kyis/ dngos grub thams cad 'gugs par byed pas lcags kyu'o// zhes so// gnyis pa khyad par gyi dam tshig tshogs 'khor la ming don dang*/ ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo// dang po la gang zag gi sgo nas dpa' bo dang dpa' mo gnyis ka 'tshogs na tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ dpa' bo 'ba' zhig tshogs na dpa' bo'i ston mo/ dpa' mo 'ba' zhig tshogs na dpa' mo'i ston mo ste/ ḍom bhi was/ dpa' bo dang bral ba'i dpa' mo dang*/ dpa' mo dang bral ba'i dpa' bo dag gis tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mi bya'o// zhes so// dus kyis dbye na/ dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi dus dang 'brel ba la tsā ru bza' ba'am/ dga' ston zhes bya'o// rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas lha'i rnal 'byor rigs mi 'dra ba bsgom pa du ma tshogs nas/ mdza' ba 'dus pa zhes bya ste/ mnyam sbyor las/ lha rnams thams cad tshogs pa na// skye bo dam pa kun tshogs pa// tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa ni// mdza' ba thams cad 'dus pa ste// sangs rgyas kun gyi brda dag gis// de bzhin mdza' ba 'dus par btags// zhes so// dgos pa'i sgo nas rims dang mu ge la sogs pa bzlog pa'i don du lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gang zag 'dus nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i bkod pa ltar 'khod de/ thams cad kyis dkyil 'khor gcig gi lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom nas tshogs kyi yo byad kyis mchod de/ so so'i dam tshig la bskul ba la sangs rgyas kyi gar zhes bya'o// mchod bya'i sgo nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro ma mchod pa la rigs ldan ma mchod pa zhes bya/ grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i bu mo lhar dmigs te mchod pa la gzhon nu'i ma'i ston mo zhes bya'o// gnyis pa la/ gnas dang dus dang yo byad dang*// gang zag cho ga dgos pa'o// dang po la/ las dang po pa'i gnas ni/ dur khrod ri yi bya skyibs dang*// de bzhin mi med grong khyer dang*// yang na dben pa'am rgya mtsho'i mthar// bza' ba 'di ni rab tu bza'// zhes sogs dang*/

ḍom bhi was/ dur khrod dang ni shing gcig gam// skyed mos tshal dang kun dga' dang*// de bzhin rang gi khyim dang ni// gzhan yang dben pa'i khyim rnams dang*// zhes so// sems brtan pa'i gnas ni/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni// zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang ni// tshan+dho nye ba'i tshan+dho dang*// de bzhin 'du ba nye 'du ba// 'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung gcod nyid// ces sogs dang*/ gnas ni dza lan+dha rar bshad// de bzhin o ḍi ya na nyid// ces bya ba la sogs pa'i gnas so// gnyis pa dus la rgyun gyi dus ni/ rgyud las/ yid btags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang*// de bzhin du yang brgyad pa nyid// sogs dang*/ sam+bu ṭi las/ zla ba mar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang*// khyad par du ni brgyad pa dang*// yar gyi ngo ni bcu pa la// mchod pa'i mchod pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes sogs dang*/ ḍom bhi was/ yar ngo'i brgyad dang bcu bzhi dang*// bco lnga dag ni rab tu bsngags// de bzhin mar ngo'i brgyad dang ni// bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga la// zhes so// khyad par gyi dus ni/ dbang rgyud rab gnas dang 'brel ba dang*/ nyer 'tshe bzlog pa'i dus ni/ gur las/ 'chi ba'i tshe 'am mu ge 'am// phas kyi 'khor lo'i gnod pa 'am// rab gnas dkyil 'khor sbyin sreg dang*// char med pa dang zhi ba la// sngags dang bsgom par ldan pa yis// gang zhig bdag ni rtag rol pa// de yi mdun du bdag 'dug ste// de ni brdzun du mi 'gyur ro// zhes sogs so// gsum pa ni/ dkyil 'khor dang gang zag mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor ba dang*/ med du mi rung ba kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sha dang*/ cho ga bzhin du btsos pa'i chang ste/ rgyud las/ rgyal mtshan dang ni mtshon bsnun dang*// lan bdun pa yang za bar bya// zhes sogs dang*/ skyes pa'i thod chen cha gcig pa// chang ni bzang po'i yongs bkang ste// zhes sogs dang*/ ḍom+bhi was/ nya dang sha la sogs par ldan// mi 'tshe ba dang skyon kun bral// sdig pa med dang ma blang ba'o// zhes so// bzhi pa gang zag ni/

dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog shas chung ba'i las dang po pa'am/ sems cung zad brtan pa yan chad/ phyag thig las/ thams cad dam tshig gcig pa dang*// thams cad rtog pa med pa dang*// ser sna nga rgyal spangs pa dang*// 'dod chags zhe sdang bral ba dang*// bla ma la gus bsam gtan ldan// phrag dog med cing rtse gcig pa// de ltar dgos pa tshogs 'khor lo// mkhas pas 'bad de gzhug par bya// zhes so// grogs kyang las dang po pa mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa'am/ rigs ldan ma'am/ rgyas btab pa'i gzhon nu ma'am/ ro ras la thod pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma bris pa lhar bskyed nas mchod pa ste/ sam ṭi las/ thod pa dgra s+t+wa mche ba las// chu srin rgyal mtshan ral gri dang*// 'phang mdung dung dang bdun du gsungs// yang dag sbyor ba'i cho ga 'di// rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod// ces gsungs so// drod chung 'bring che sogs thob pas ni/ rtog pa mnyam pa'am/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ brda dang brda'i lan byas te tshogs la 'du ba ste/ phyag rgya phyag rgya'i lan gyis ni// dam tshig gi ni rnam par dbye// de la rnal 'byor mas smras pa// e ma bu ni snying rje che// gal te phreng ba lag ston na// 'du bar bya zhes smra ba yin// phreng ba mngon par btang byas nas// dam tshig la mnos brtul zhugs bzang*// de la phyi rol zhes 'du ba// bzang po'i spyod yul gnas pa ni// de la 'du bar rnal 'byor mas// gang smras de ltar thams cad bya// sogs so// lnga pa cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po la/ gnas khang brgyan te tshogs gtor bshams/ slob dpon nang du byon nas sngon la bzhugs pa/ sgo bas brda dang brda'i lan byas te shes na nang du 'jug pa/ dbang la sogs pas rgan rim bzhin gral bya ba/ lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab pa/ yig brgyas rgyud sbyangs shing srung 'khor bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/

ḍom+bhi was/ sa gzhi ba yi lngas byug la// me tog dri zhim sna tshogs dgram// zhes dang*/ phyag thig las/ dang po yid 'phrog dges pa yis// me tog dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// de ru sna tshogs mchod pa ni// rtse gcig gis ni legs par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ de nyid bcu ni yongs shes shing*// gsum po dag las dge slong mchog /'bring po dge tshul zhes bya ste// de dag tha ma khyim pa'o// zhes so// gal te dge slong yin yang rmongs la/ dge tshul lam/ dge bsnyen mkhas shing rgyud ston nus na/ gcig shos de khyim gzhan du yo byad bzang pos mnyes par byas la/ dge tshul lam dge bsnyen gyis gtso bo bya'o// de bzhin du gzhan du gnyis la'ang shes par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ phyi nas 'ongs pa rnams kyis/ khyod kyi dam tshig la ni khro bo dbyug pa sngon po mdzes// dngos grub phyag na dbyig tho dang ni rin chen bcings pa 'dzin// dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo 'du bar 'khor sgrol khum// mkha' mdzes rnal 'byor ma yis nang du bdag thong cig /ces sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dang po'i bdun pa nas byung ba'i brda dang brda'i lan bya shes pa rnams nang du 'jug go /bzhi pa ni/ dbang dang*/ brtul zhugs dang*/ ye shes dang*/ skye ba dang*/ rim pas rgan pa'i go rim bzhin gral bya ste/ ḍom+bhi was/ de nas slob dpon stan bzang la// dbus kyi phyogs su yang dag bzhugs// de bzhin stan ni bzang po la// rnal 'byor pa yi 'khor lo g.yas// rnal 'byor ma yi g.yon du bshad// zhes so// lnga pa dang drug pa ni rtogs par sla'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor mchod pas tshim pa/ snying ga'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsi myong bas tshim pa/ chos skyong dang*/ 'byung po gtor mas tshim pa/ dam tshig dang ldan pa'i skye bo kha zas kyis tshim pa/ skye mched kyi lha glu gar dang rol mos tshim pa/ bde chen lhan skyes kyi ye shes kyis tshim pa'o// dang po ni/

rtsa rgyud dang gur gyi dgongs pas/ dngos gzhi bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa gcig la tshim pa drug bya ba dang*/ sam ṭi'i dgongs pas bdag dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka byas nas tshim pa drug bya ba ste/ gang ltar yang tshim pa drug tu thams cad 'dus so// gnyis pa phyag thig las/ dum bu gcig pa'i mtshan ldan snod// bla ma'i mdun du bzhag par bya// yang na dum bu gsum pa ni// lha yi chang gis bkang bar bya// zhes so// gsum pa ni/ de nyid las/ bza' ba sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i// dang por gtor ma chen po sbyin// zhes dang*/ bzhi pa'ang dam tshig mchog gi ye shes te/ dad pa yi ni gza' ru za// zhes so// lnga pa'ang*/ shin tu dbyangs ni snyan pa yis// yid 'phrog pa yi glu blangs bya// zhes sogs dang*/ drug pa'ang*/ dgos pa'i dam tshig zin nas su// 'khor lo dang bcas rig rab tshim// zhes so// der dam tshig gi sbyin pa ni/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa dang*// rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du zo// zhes sogs dang*// bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags dri ma rnam par spangs// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes sogs so// gsum pa rjes la rdo rje'i glus byin gyis brlabs pa/ bkra shis kyi tshig gis shis par brjod pa/ lhag gtor gtong zhing lhag chad bskang ba/ smon lam gdab cing 'dod don gsol ba/ bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol ba/ bsrung ba byas nas las rjes bsdu ba'o// de dag kyang phyag thig las/ de rnams mchod pa dngos grub ni// gang zhig sems la bsam pa yod// lhag ma'i gtor ma bzung nas ni// dgon pa chen por btang bar bya// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so// tshul 'di dag rgyas par grub chen ḍom+bhi wa'i gzhung na bzhugs shing*/ lag tu blang ba ni man ngag gi rim pa las shes par bya'o// drug pa dgos pa la gtso bor gyur pa mthar thug gi dgos pa ste/

tshogs rdzogs nas 'tshang rgya ba ni/ gur las/ bde dang rang bzhin gar dang ni// glu dang rol mo'i sgra byed dang*// dri dang phreng ba byug pa yi// zhes sogs nas/ rig pa'i rgyal po rab tu 'grub// ces dang*/ phyag thig las/ dam tshig bsrung na grub pa ni// lha yi dbang phyug rnyed pa'o// zhes so// gnas skabs kyi dgos pa ni thun mong dngos grub ci 'dod pa 'grub ste/ rgyud las/ gang du bzod pas 'dod don kun// 'grub pa can gyi dngos grub 'gyur// zhes so// zhes bza' ba'i dam tshig gi rnam par bshad pa bdud rtsi'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can dang*/ rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rgyal ba mus pa chen po ste yongs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku du mas rjes su bzung ba'i rnal 'byor pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa rnams la brten nas rang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir legs par sbyar ba 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig gnyis pa ni/ tshogs mchod tshogs gnyis myur 'grub las 'byung ba bzhin las bar skabs kyi cho ga'i yan lag kha yar bsnan pa ni/ tshogs mchod kyi yi ge de nyid las/ bla ma mchog dang rnal 'byor ma// gnyis med zhabs la gus btud nas// rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i// tshogs mchod cho ga 'dir bshad bya// 'dir nā ro mkha' spyod kyi tshogs mchod bya ba la/ sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying pos/ sngon 'gro gnas dus rten bshams la/ mchod rdzas te bzhi dang*/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga rjes sogs bshad pa ltar/ dang po gnas ni/ gnas khang phyag dar bya zhing chag chag gdab/ maṇ+ḍal/ me tog rten dgram pa sogs dang*/ gnyis pa dus ni tshogs bsags par 'dod na yar ngo'i tshes bcu/

sgrib pa dag par 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcur bya bar gsungs/ gsum pa rten ni/ spro na bdag 'jug skabs ltar dkyil 'khor gsum po bsham pa'am/ yang na sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor chos 'byung sngags phreng sogs phyag len ltar dang*/ bsdu na me long la chang chos 'byung bris pa'i dbus su me tog dmar po'i tshom bu gcig bkod pa stegs la bshams/ bzhi pa mchod rdzas ni me tog bdug spos mar me rten gyi g.yon du bshams/ dri chab gtor ma zhal zas gsum g.yas su ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba mdun du bsham mo// tshogs kyi yo byad ni ci 'byor pa bsham mo// gzhan 'di bzhin la gtor ma gsum dgos so// dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ maṇ+ḍal zhu 'bul la sogs byed par gsungs pa tshogs pa yod na zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad bde kye nas gsungs pa ltar yin yang*/ rang gcig pu nyams su len par spros pa mi dgos/ cho ga gzhan rnams sa chen gyis tho tsam las ma gsungs pas 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung ltar don bsdus te brjod na mdo rgyas mtshams pas 'di ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma dmar gtor chab kyis bran la lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa nas/ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos/ bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las brtsams pa la bar du gcod par ma byed par gzhan du dengs shig ces dang*/ sum+bha ni brjod cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bskrad/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub bskyed pa'i se gol shar nas phyogs bzhir g.yas skor dang*/ mtshams bzhir g.yon bskor gdab cing zhal bzhi pa sum+bha rkang pa re re brjod pa ste tshar gnyis kyis bgegs bskrad/ mdun gyi nang mchod mngon rtogs ltar byin rlabs byas te/

lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsir g.yon bskor du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bri zhing oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ bdud rtsi des lag pa g.yas g.yon phan tshun du gtor zhing mnye tshul bya/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis rang gi dpral mgrin snying ka gsum du thig le re bkod nas rang lus dag par byas/ gnas khang dang spyi mchod rnams la gtor bas lha rdzas las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du mchod pa rgya chen po dwangs shing thogs pa med par dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pa ni spyir gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa yin no// skabs 'dir skyabs sems dang khyad par rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas nan tan du byas la sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor nas gzung sgrub thabs ltar mngon rtogs bzlas pa sogs dkyus bzhin bsam mi khyab kyi bar byas te thun mtshams kyi lhar langs nas mchod rdzas rnams la nang mchod kyi bdud rtsis gtor zhing*/ sum+bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhes sogs nas rgyas par gyur cig gi bar dang*/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa sgrub mchod ltar ro// de nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gsum bkod pa'am/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor ram/ me long tshom bu dang dang bcas pa gang yin bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun bskyed kyi rim pa sgrub mchod bdag 'jug gi yi ge ltar lhar bskyed pa nas gzung bstod pa'i bar bya'o// skabs 'dir gtor ma 'bul bar gsung ba dang po sgrub thabs ltar rnal 'byor ma la 'bul/ gnyis pa chos skyong ni gur zhal la gtso bor byed pa sa skya pa rang lugs yin/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'bul lo// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad rnams sgrub thabs kyi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/

tshogs phud tshang ba snod gcig tu bshams pa bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la dbul te/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan zhing yid 'phrog pa// legs byas 'di ni bla ma lhar bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dril bu ḍeṃ gi an+tar tai lo pa// nā ro pham thing klog skya mal lo'i zhabs// brtse chen snying po tshogs mchod bzhes su gsol// rje btsun sku mched chos rje khu dbon dang*// dkon mchog dpal dang grub chen brag phug pa// chos rje bla ma seṅge rgyal mtshan zhabs// rgyal ba mchog dbyangs tshogs mchod bzhes su gsol// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rings pa dang tshar chen chos kyi rje// 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse bslab gsum rgyal mtshan zhabs// dbang phyug rab brtan tshogs mchod bzhes su gsol// bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub dang*// mkhyen rab byams pa'i mtshan dang rmor chen rje// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma tshogs mchod bzhes su gsol// gzhan yang dpal ldan tshul khrims shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan rje// rdo rje 'chang

kun dga' bzang po/ dang mus chen sems dpa' che// bsod nams seṅge bud+dha rat+na'i zhabs// sa skya lo tsā tshogs mchod bzhes su gsol// snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje// gang gi thugs sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang*// sangs rgyas dpal bzang dpal ldan rgyal po'i zhabs// bha dra shrī tshogs mchod bzhes su gsol// nam mkha' dbang phyug chos kyi dbang phyug dang*// sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan 'jam dbyangs kun dga' mtshan// bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis dang*// puṇ+ya rat+na tshogs mchod bzhes su gsol// oṃ ma hā gu ru badz+ra ni wi d+ye āḥ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin dngos grub 'gugs byed pa'i// ba lang khyi rta glang chen mi sha ste// sgrub pa'i dam rdzas lcags kyu rnam lnga dang*// yum lnga'i rang bzhin dri chen dri chu dang*// byang sems dkar dmar sha chen dwangs ma lnga// zag med ye shes bdud rtsir byin rlabs 'di// lhan skyes zhing skyes sngags skyes mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum bdag he ru ka dpal dang*// rje btsun mkha' spyod dbang mo'i dkyil 'khor la// mchod pa 'bul lo dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// oṃ badz+ra a ha ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī kha kha khā hi khā hi/ i maṃ ba liṃ bhuñja tha/ pi ba tha/ ma ma karma sā dha ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ swā hā/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha// sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// chos skyong nor lhar bcas pa thams cad la// tshogs mchod gus pas 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// rang gang byed kyi yi dam dang chos skyong tshang ma'i gtor sngags mthar a kā ros btags pas phul/ tshogs chang gi phud kyang snod du blug ste/

bla ma dang lha tshogs rnams la 'bul zhing*/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*// rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bdud rtsi mchog gis mchod par bgyi// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun bsal nas// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig /sa yi snying po 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho dang*// de bzhin me tog 'bras bu'i tshogs rnams dang*// rtsi sman sna tshogs sbyar ba'i phabs dang ni// 'gro ba dag byed gyur pa'i chu gtsang rnams// snod dang rkyen dang sna tshogs sbyor ba dang*// dus kyi 'gyur ba bzang pos yongs smin par// bya zhing dwangs ma'i dwangs ma las byung ba'i// 'di yi rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs pa yin// char dang shel ltar snang ba'i lbu ba yis// 'phreng ba mu tig phreng bas spras 'dra ba// mthong bas mig gi dpal ster chil chil sgra// thos pas rna ba'i dpal la bsung ngad kyis// dri 'dzin dbang po'i tshim par byed pa yin// kun nas myongs pas lce yi dpal yang bde// grang dang tsha ba'i tshe na drod dang ni// bsil byed lus kyi dbang po bde ba'i rgyu// mya ngan 'thibs pa sel ba'i nyi ma ste// dga' bde'i bsil ba byed pa'i zla ba'ang yin// shes rab me lce 'bar byed rlung yin la// smra 'dod rnams kyi spobs pa'i dpal yang yin// g.yul ngor zhugs pas brtul zhugs skyed byed cing*// 'dod ldan rnams kyi bde ba'ang rgyas byed yin// zhir 'dod rnams kyi rgyud la 'di yis ni// ting 'dzin dam pa lhug par bskyed pa yin// de phyir 'di ni btung ba'i phul yang yin// longs spyod rnams kyi snying por gyur pa yin// de slad 'dis ni mchod 'os mchod pa dang*// sbyin 'os rnams la sbyin par bya ba yin// kha dog dri ro nus pa bdud rtsi 'di// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dril bu ḍeṃ ga an+tar tai lo pa// nā ro pham thing klog skya mal blo'i zhabs// brtse ba chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// rje btsun sku mched chos rje khu dbon dang*// dkon mchog dpal dang grub chen brag phug pa// chos rje bla ma seṅge rgyal mtshan zhabs// rgyal ba mchog dbyangs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rings pa dang tshar chen chos kyi rje// 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse bslab gsum rgyal mtshan zhabs// dbang phyug rab brtan zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog grub dang*// mkhyen rab byams pa'i mtshan dang rmor chen rje// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhan yang dpal ldan tshul khrims shar chen rje// rdo rje 'chang dang mus chen sems dpa' che// bsod nams seṅge bud+dha rat+na'i zhabs// sa skya lo tsā'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje// gang gi thugs sras 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang*// sangs rgyas dpal bzang dpal ldan rgyal po'i zhabs// bha dra shrī'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// nam mkha' dbang phyug chos kyi dbang phyug dang*// sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan// bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis dang*// puṇ+ya rat+na'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// gzhan yang 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs khrod 'dir// bde gshegs bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba la// 'gran zla bral ba'i mkhas grub ji snyed tshogs// zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho sras dang slob mar bcas// bstan pa rgya mtsho'i srung ma drag shul can// 'khor dang bcas la mchod pa dam pa 'bul// lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la// dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa 'di 'phul nas// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// de nas dam tshig sbol ba'i phyir rdo rje'i slob dpon gyi drung du ma dā na'i

chang snod pad+ma bhañja thod pa dpral ba rang la bstan la bzhag de'i steng du ba la cung zhig bzhag la las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal/ pad kor byas la/ rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol// bdag gi tshogs kyi khyad par 'di// dad pa'i sems kyis 'bul lags kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// ces brjod dpon slob rnams kyis/ e ma zhi ba chen po kye// tshogs chen 'bar bas nyon mongs bsreg /de 'di'i bde ba chen po ste// kun kyang a ho su kha che// a ho ma hā su kha hoḥ zhes brjod/ yang phyag gsum dang pad skor byas la/ 'di ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'dus pa la ni the tshom med// bram zer gdol pa khyi dang phag /rang bzhin gcig tu rol du gsol// ces pa'i lan du/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de bzhin nyid la gus phyag 'tshal// a ho ma hā su kha hoḥzhes brjod/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes lag pa gnyis pad+ma'i phyag rgya las srin lag g.yas kyis steng gi ba la 'dzin pas/ rdo rje slob dpon nas rim bzhin ma dā na 'grim tshar ba dang tshogs kyi rdzas rnams ma tshang ba med pa slob dpon la nyis 'gyur sogs dpon slob thams cad la lag pa gnyis kas dbul zhing*/ len pa pos kyang lag pa gnyis kas pad skor gyis blang bar bya zhing*/ a ho mahā su kha hoḥskabs 'dir 'phags pa rin po ches lag mchod byed par gsungs pa bde mchog ltar dgos pa ha cang rgyas grags pa/ 'dir 'phags pa'i gsung bde mchog nag po lugs kyi mchod phreng las btus pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa la bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing mnyes nas lag mthil du sor mo lnga bsdus pa'i dbus su sen mo lnga la me tog gi thig le bkod pa zla ba'i gdan drug tu bsam pa'i mthe bor oṃ ha dkar po/ mdzub mor na ma hi ser po/ gung mo la swā hā hu dmar po/

srin lag bo ṣa ṭa he nag po/ mthe'u chung la hūm̐ hūm̐ ho dmar ser/ sen mo lnga'i dbus su phaṭa haṃ ljang gu/ lag mthil du tshom bu lnga bkod pa zla gdan du bsam pa'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor gyis rim bzhin ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo/ hriṃ oṃ dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams dpa' bo dpa' mo lha'i rnam par bsgom dgos kyang gsal ma theb na yig 'bru'i rnam par bsgom pas don lnga'i rang bzhin yin no// lag pa'i sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams lnga ltung byed/ gsod byed/ 'gugs byed/ pad+ma gar dmar ma/ pad+ma'i drā ba can ma snying po'i rnal 'byor ma lngar shes par bya/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan/ lag pa'i rgyab tu shar bar blta ba'am/ mdun bskyed dang ma 'brel na/ lag par me tog gi thig le bkod pa rdo rje rnal 'byor mar mos la/ phaiṃ zhes pho nya gsum dbyer mi 'byed par gyur par bsam la oṃ gsum ma dang dpa' bo dpa' mo'i cho ga'i sngags rnams gong ltar brjod/ puṣ+pe sogs rnam lngas mchod cing tshogs rdzas nas cung zad re lag mthil du bzhag nas mchod pas mnyes par bsam/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa la bdud rtsi gtor zhing lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnyes pas lha rnams snyoms par zhugs par bsams la/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis rang gi dpral mgrin snying khar reg cing mthar lus thams cad la byug pas lha thams cad kyang lus la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod do// lag mchod 'di bde mchog gi dgongs don yin la/ bsdu na gong du bshad pa'i bdud rtsis lag pa g.yas g.yon phan tshun du gtor mnye byed pa/ gnas gsum thig le byed pa des kyang go chod par snang*/ de nas lag g.yon pa'i kun spyod kyis 'khrid yig tu bshad pa ltar kha zas kyi rnal 'byor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor gyis gsal btab la/

nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis zhen med du tshim par longs spyod par bya'o// g.yeng bar mi 'gyur ba'i glu gar dang rol mo'i sgra sogs phyi nang gi lha mchod pa'i bsam pas bya zhing*/ dus kun bdag dang snang ba thams cad rje btsun ma'i sku dang*/ sgra thams cad grags stong rnal 'byor ma'i sngags dang*/ bsam pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs pa/ phyi nang gi nyams myong bde ba thams cad kyis rnal 'byor ma mchod par bsam zhing*/ yang yang lha'i rnam par gsal 'debs dgos par gsung*/ de nas lhag ma bsdus pa la 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas chang gi kha phru btab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi u tsiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swā hā/ lan gsum gyis sbyin/ kol+la e ri sogs kyi rdo rje'i glu blangs la/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las byung gyur zhing*// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo pad+mar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa// bden pa des ni bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /mdun bskyed kyi lha la/ bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang*/ dpal dang*/ 'byor pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ 'chi ba'i tshe mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid pa dang*/ mthar thug bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsung tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin pas// bden pa des ni lha mo 'di dag gis// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'i bden stobs lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol gyur pa// de ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog

/ces pa'i smon lam btab/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyi bzod gsol bya/ mdun bskyed bris 'bur gyi rten yod na/ 'di ni gzugs dang zhes sogs dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs bya/ dkyil 'khor dang sin+dhu ra sogs kyi rten yod na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs dang*/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ gtor ma gsum rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bskyal/ rang gi gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsrung*/ go cha'i sngags brjod cing rgyas btab la nyal ba'i rnal 'byor chos bzhin du bya'o// phan yon ni/ 'phags pa rin po ches/ de ltar rgyun du rnal 'byor du byed pa ni sdig pa dang*/ dam tshig nyes pa 'dag pa dang*/ lha dang bla ma'i thugs dam bskang zhing*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du rdzogs par 'gyur ro// zhes so// zhes pa 'di yang sa dge sogs ris med bstan pa rin po cher mtshungs med chos kyi spyan ldan zhi ba lha sprul pa'i sku 'phags pa dge legs rgyal mtshan nas gsung bris gnang rten bzang po dang bcas/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs mchod kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bzhed srol bzhin la 'bul tshig sogs rgyas pa yod pa zhig dang*/ rdo rje'i glu bod skad du sdeb pa zhig dgos zhes bkas bskul yang*/ rnam g.yeng le lo'i dbang gis lo zla du mar chams skyur lta bu lus mod/ slar dam pa rnams kyi thugs bzhed rnam dkar la ji snyam du yang mi sems par lus na rang nyid ngan 'gro'i rgyu las ma 'das pas/ de sogs nyes pa mtha' dag bshags pa'i phyir du sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dam pa mang pos mdzad pa'i tshogs mchod yi ge rnams lhan cig tu bkod pa 'di la nyes tshogs med snyam yang skyes sbyangs kyi blo gros dman pa'i khar rnam g.yeng le los bab col mchis na skyabs gnas dam pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad nas dge des 'gro kun mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

༈ / dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i glu'i dgongs don bod skad du sdeb pa bzhugs// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje'i glu'i dgongs don bod skad du sdeb pa ni/ kwa ye bde pa'i gnas dang bo lā dag /kye kye zhing dang kak+ko la sbyar ba// tshogs su cang ti 'u ni dkrol bar bya// snying rje'i gnas pa'i ca co mi bya 'o// de yi dus su stobs ni za bar bya// 'bad pas myos byed btung bar bya ba 'o// kwa ye skal ldan nang du gzhug par bya// skal ba med pa spangs pa nyid du bya// bzhi mnyam gla rtsi dang ni sih+la dang*// ga bur rnams ni byug pa nyid du bshad// sā lu las ni skyes pa dag tshod ma// dus der lto ba gang ba za bar bya// 'ong ba dang ni 'gro ba byed pa na// dag dang ma dag par ni mi blta 'o// cha shas med pa lus la gdags par bya// dus der skyes pa'i ro ni dbul bar bya// 'dus te snyoms par 'jug pa byed pas na// reg min de dus spang bar mi bya 'o// zhes rdor glu mchan rnying pa na bshad 'dug kyang*/ 'di ni nges par rgya skad du 'don dgos pa rje btsun gong ma rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i phyag len yin pa'ang dgongs 'jags zhu/ sarba dā maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsnyen thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang*// dbyer med rje btsun rdo rje la// gus btud nas ni de bskyed pa'i// thabs mchog dngos grub myur mgyogs bri// de yang 'di'i chos skor legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas zla ba gsum la sogs par 'tsho ba'i yo byad bsags nas/ de nas tshes bcu la sogs dus khyad par can gyi tshe/ gnas dben zhing dgra rnams kyis 'tshe dogs med pa rang dbang can gyi khang bur phyag dar byas/ bris 'bur gyi rten mchod bshams/

spro na gtor ma brgya rtsa dang cha gsum btang*/ rang gi 'dod don 'grub pa'i gsol ba btab cing phrin las bcol/ de nas byi ba sogs kyi rkyen mi yong ba'i stegs bur gtor ma lnga tshar ram ma 'byor na gnyis nang gi babs dang bstun pa'i gang bder bsham/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sogs kyi mchod pa kha gso ba'i mtheb kyu rnams kyang sta gon bya/ mal stan kyang byung na kha shar du'am lho ru phyogs par 'og tu rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i khar/ sgo khri la sogs pa'i steng du stan nang tshangs can bshams/ de'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod la sogs pa bsham/ de nas phyi dro'i dus su mtshams bsdam par bya ste/ khang bu'i sgor mtshams tho brtan po rgyab dkar rtsis bran/ mtshams tho rgyal chen du bskyed pa'i lugs yod kyang phyag len la mi mdzad pas ma bris/ de nas mtshams 'og tu 'dzom pa'i 'os 'di dang 'di tsho ma gtogs gzhan 'ong du yang mi 'jug cing tho nang 'dir mtshams 'di ma grol bar du mi gtong snyam pa bya/ mtshams 'og tu grogs byed pa gnyis tsam dang khams ma bde ba zhig bsring dgos pas drung 'tsho ba yang 'jug par bshad kyang rang gi gzugs po'i babs

glo bur gyi nad byung na ci bya dang bstun la bya'i/ mi dgos kha med ma yin no// skabs su dogs pa dri dgos pas rab ni chos 'di zhus pa'i bla ma/ de ma yin na dge rgan nyams can zhig 'jug de nas mtshams 'di ma grol bar la rkyen 'gal che chung gang ci byung yang mi thon snyam pa dang*/ yang dmigs bsal yod na 'di 'dra gcig la thon dgos byung na ma gtogs so snyam pa'i dogs pa sngon bsus nas bya gsung ba yod mod/ byung na ni mtshams ma grol bar steng nas ri lhung 'og nas chu rdol kyang 'thon mi thub snyam pa'i blo tsam bskyed nas mtshams mal du bsdad/ skyil krung bcas te bsdad nas thog mar bka' drin che ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod brgyud 'debs ci rigs bya/ ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can gyi don du bsnyen pa byed snyam pa rang 'dod ma 'dres pa gal che/ 'khor ba la skyo shas dang sems can la snying rje dang bla ma la mos gus dang bcas te skyid sdug legs nyes thams cad bla ma dang dkon mchog mkhyen snyam pa'i blo slod lings kyis bkal ba'i ngang nas rang gnas pa'i sa phyogs skad cig gis rdo rje'i gur khang phyi rol thams cad mda'i drwa ba dang ye shes kyi me 'bar bas bskor bar bsam/ ngag tu oṃ sum+bha ni sngags mang du bzlas/ sngags gu gul bdug mthar oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum brjod/ 'dir spro na gnas yo byin rlabs dkyil chog ltar bya'o// de nas skyabs 'gro yig brgya nas brtsams te sgrub thabs kyi dkyus las mjug tu bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas thun bsdus la gtor ma bya ste/ bkra shis kyi bar bya/ zas kyi bya ba sogs spyod lam dgos pa rnams bya/ de nas srod thun la 'jug ste bzlas pa cung zad byas/ thun bsdus nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal lo// de nas sang nam gyi sum cha tsam gyi tshe ldang ba'i rnal 'byor sogs bya ste/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te thun bsdu ba'i bar

skyabs 'gro gang mang byas pa'i mthar dkyus la 'jug ste/ yun ring thung 'tshams par byas la gnyid chung cung zad cig bya/ des nangs par khams bde rog yong gyin gda'/ de nas nam langs pa dang khams bseng dgos na bseng la/ snga thun btsugs ja thug sogs bzlas pa'i skabs su btung chog par bshad pas de bzhin bya/ 'on kyang zas rag pa gzhan za mi chog go /de nas nyi ma tsha steng ma yol ba bzlas pa bya/ de nas thun bsdus gtor bsngo bsdus pa tsam byas te/ yi dam la sgrub thabs bzhin 'bul/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor btang na rjes chog dkyus bzhin bya/ de nas chag med yod na 'dir bya/ rjes zas kyi bya ba cung zad bya/ ngal bso ste/ lus sems la gnad ma bskur bar lhod de bsdad la gnyid ma khug par bya/ de nas yang gung thun la zhugs nas bzlas pa 'ga' bya thun bsdus/ gtor bsngo rgyas pa bya ste/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis bzlas pa'i grangs 'grig par shes par bya ste/ de mtshams bsdad pa'i gung gi thun dang po la skyabs 'gro gang mang bya ste tha na'ang brgya rtsa gcig tsam 'gro bar bya/ sang gi thor thun nas bzung yi ge brgya pa 'bum phrag tsam thun bzhir bcad pa'am/ yang na thor thun dang gung thun sbrel nas thun gsum du byas kyang rung ngo*// yig brgya ni 'bum phrag bcu sogs byung na'ang shin tu legs la/ de lta bu ma byung na zhag bdun tsam yig brgya nyer gcig sogs snga thun la bzlas rgyun du dal brel skabs dang bstun pa gsung*/ yig brgya 'bum phrag gcig song nas bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi la 'bum phrag bzhis rab na 'grub bo// 'bru 'bum byed na 'bum phrag sum cu so gnyis sam grub na so lnga bya'o// srod thun la thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor yid ches nges rgyun du bya/ thor thun la nang gi mkha' spyod sgrub pa cung zad re ma chag pa bya/ gzhan bzlas pa kho na la brtson par bya/ de ltar bzlas pa'i skabs su byung na khrid nas 'byung ba ltar gyi dmigs pa bya/

yang skabs rer rang lhag pa'i lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma rnam snang he ru kar bsam ste de la sems 'dzin cing bzlas/ res rang lhar gsal ba la sems 'dzin cing bzlas/ re res rang la me 'od bun bun 'phros pas 'jig rten thams cad gang bar bsams nas bzlas/ snod thams cad chos 'byung dmar gsal bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can du gsal zhing bzlas/ rang sngags 'dren pa bzhin du dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can rnams dang lus kyi srin bu sogs/ res sems can thams cad rnal 'byor mar gyur nas rang dang dus mnyam du bzlas pa byed par bsams nas bzlas/ res sa rdo ri brag la sogs pa rnal 'byor mar gsal btab nas sngar bzhin bzlas/ res rna bar thos tshad kyi sgra thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i sgrar mos nas bzlas/ res snang ba thams cad sems sems snang thams cad bden pa med/ med bzhin du sna tshogs su snang ba nyid dag gad mo bro snyam du bsams nas bzla ba sogs te/ de dag gcig la sun na gcig la dmigs pa spos shing bzla yi/ dug gsum gyi rnam rtog gi dbang du ma shor ba zhig e yong lta ba bya ba yin te dgos med kyi rnam rtog rgya yan gyis sems g.yengs nas bzlas pa byas kyang ngal ba don med du gsung ba lta bur snang ste/ bde mchog gi rgyud las/ gzhan du mi 'gro'i sems kyis ni// de lta'i tshul gyis bzlas pa bya// yul gzhan blo ni 'gro ba yis// bskal par bzlas kyang mi 'grub bo// zhes gsungs so// spyod 'jug las/ bzlas dang brjod dang dka' thub kun// yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang*// sems gzhan g.yeng bas byas na ni// de nyid rig pas don med gsung*// zhes gsungs so// phyi nas chas gsar pa len dgos byung na 'phral du rang gi mdun du mi btang bar re zhig nang gzhan zhig tu bzhag de nas rim gyis btang*/ khyad par gshin po'i rdzas lta bu de'i ring la ci yang mi len/ len na dngos su mi spyod/

spyod dgos byung na khrus chu gtor sngags gu gul bdugs nas spyod do// dam nyams dang sdom nyams dang rang dang nang mi gtsang ba sogs kyi sa nas bza' btung len dgos byung na/ rang gis mthong ba byas mtshams g.yog pa la ster/ de yang skabs su mi bde na rang mi za bar re zhig gzhan du bzhag go /phyogs kyi yi ge sogs byung na mal sar mi klog pa gzhan zhig tu klog phyir yi ge lta bu bskur dgos byung na'ang mal der mi 'bri gzhan zhig tu bris nas rim par phyir bskur ro// rang gis gzhan du chas ka phyir 'don dgos na'ang phral 'don mi bya bar de ring phyi sgo'i nang du bzhag la sang nyin phyir 'don/ nang du chas ka gsar pa 'jug dgos na'ang des shes par bya/ mdor na phyi'i 'grul dang dkor rdzas dang grib rdzas la shin tu 'dzem par bya'o// rkyen dbang gis nang du mi gsar pa mi btang ka med byung na sngags gu gul gyis bdug la btang ngo*// zhes gsung mod/ byung na btang mi dgos pa tsam i yong blta'o// bsnyen pa byed lugs nas 'dra ma bya ba mgo nas lhod tsam byed sum cha tsam nas shin tu 'gyur ba bya/ grol khar yang cung zad lhod du btang la mtshams dang zhe mi 'dres par bya'o// nad lta bu byung yang thun ma chag tsam cis kyang bya/ rgyun gyi bza' btung che chung mang nyung cha 'grig pa rang bya/ thun grol tshod kyang nyi tshod sogs ma 'khyugs par byas la kha sang gi song ba'i grangs de ring 'gro bas chag med byed tshad snga thun dang dgong thun gyi rjes la ma chag tsam re bya/ rgyas na bzlas pa la gnod/ de lta bu'i sgo nas bsnyen pa'i grangs song ba dang sbyin sreg bya ba'am/ ma grub na yi ge brgya pa mang du bzla'o// mthar dus bzang po'i nyin snga dro'i thun bsdus pa tsam byas la gtor ma gsar pa bshams/ rnying pa rnams gsos te gtor bsngos rgyas pa bya/ shes na bskang gso yang bya zhing mthar gtor ma 'bul ba sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar byas la de nas mtshams tho bsdus nas/

dam tshig gtsang ma'i mi gcig nyis dang 'phrad la ja bzang ba la sogs pa'i dga' ston rgya chen bya/ sang nyin steng du 'thon nas bskor ba bya/ gnang nyin lta bu phyi rol du 'thon nas ri lta bu la skyo bsang du 'gro ba dang mchod rten bskor ba sogs byas nas rim gyis grol/ de ltar mkha' spyod dpal mo bsnyen pa'i thabs// rgyas min nyung ngus legs par bshad 'di yang*// rang dang gzhan la cung zad phan pa'i blos// snyoms las pa yis mang mkhar mthon bor sbyar// 'di la nyes pa gang mchis pa// sgo gsum sdig dang lhan cig tu// bla ma rdo rje btsun mo yi// spyan sngar bshags so sbyang du gsol// 'dis kyang rang dang skal mnyam gyi// sems can rnams la phan gyur nas// rdo rje phag mo mnyes pa'i mthar// ris med 'gro ba brten par shog/ ༈ / bzlas pa'i nang nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i oṃ gsum ma 'di phan yon che ste bsgrub bya mkha' 'gro grangs med kyi gsung gi snying po yin cing rgyu mtshan rgyas par ngag las shes dgos/ 'di'i bsnyen pa song nas ma rgyud yum skor man chad kyi slob dpon gyi las la dbang zhing*/ gzhan rgyud las/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// mkha' 'gro ma dang rang gtso mo// mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir// sngags ni snyan gsan 'bebs par brjod// dper na skyes bu la la zhig /skad cig nga ros 'bod pa na// thos pa tsam gyis 'ong bar 'gyur// de bzhin skad cig sangs rgyas gshegs// sngags ma bzlas par mi 'grub cing*// sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin// zhes so// ༈ /zhar byung rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i 'da' kha ma ma chag tsam bya/ sbyin sreg gi yig cha paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang sogs kyis mdzad pa'i khung thub kyi steng nas bya zhing bcu cha la sbyin sreg 'bul sngags kyang byung na oṃ gsum ma rang gis dbul/ de ltar yun ring na cha rkyen ma 'grigs na mgo mjug gnyis su oṃ gsum tshar re dang gzhan rdzas sngags rkyang pas go chod par gsungs so// kun dga' tshul khrims sam/

mchan bu 'di rnams dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis btab pa dge/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
